_README: Manual fixtures / score corrections. The World Cup is fully covered by football-data, so you normally won't need this — but you can add an entry here to override a wrong score, or add a game the feed is missing.
_how_to: To CORRECT a score: add an entry whose "id" is that game's football-data id — it overrides the feed.
To ADD a missing game: use a unique whole number id >= 9000000, set home/away display names, kickoff_utc, status, scores, competition and group_label.
